title: Mini-bisect canary with traffic snapshots and automatic warmstart rollback oracle
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: Adds a mini-bisect canary controller that snapshots traffic distributions and supports automatic rollback if warmstart regressions are detected. Opt-in via rollout policy flag. No changes to public API surface unless feature flag enabled.
description: Summary: Introduce a lightweight 'mini-bisect' canary mode and traffic snapshotting to speed up diagnosis and automate rollback for warmstart regressions. Motivation: We observed slow, manual bisect workflows when a canary exhibits intermittent regressions related to cache warmstart/kv-cache priming. This PR implements a controller pattern that runs short-window bisect-style probes, records traffic snapshots (input distribution, sequence-length buckets, metadata tags), and evaluates a compact set of metric comparisons to decide an automatic rollback. Design: 1) controller: new MiniBisectController that coordinates N short probe waves (default 3), each wave splits a small, orthogonal slice of traffic to the candidate model. 2) traffic snapshots: proto-compact JSON blobs capturing token-length histograms, request metadata tags, and sampled request hashes; snapshots are stored in the rollout namespace and retained for 48h. 3) warmstart oracle: compares per-wave latency p95, kv-cache hit-rate estimate, and loss-proxy signal (existing quality metrics) against baseline with configurable thresholds and a decay-weighted scoring; if oracle score crosses rollback threshold, controller triggers an immediate revert to previous model and emits forensic snapshot bundle to the audit log. 4) Autoscaling safety: the controller coordinates with scheduler to throttle probe concurrency to avoid autoscaler thrash. 5) Opt-in config: rollout policy field 'mini_bisect: {enabled:true, waves:3, snapshot_ttl:48h}' and feature-flag rollout.mini_bisect.enable. Backwards compatibility: defaults disabled; no surface change to SDKs. Testing: unit tests for snapshot serialization + controller simulator harness; e2e in perf-canary lab using synthetic traffic. Rollout plan: behind feature flag, staged on staging, then limited production on internal customers for 2 weeks. See linked Linear tasks ENG-4812 ENG-4890 for follow-ups.

review_comments: Aisha: Nice approach — can we keep snapshots size-bounded? Please add a deterministic truncation policy.
Author reply: Added snapshot TTL and size cap (1MB) with streaming compression; updated serializer.
Daniel: How do we avoid cascading rollbacks if baseline is noisy? Suggest decay-weighted scoring and min-probe floor.
Author reply: Implemented decay-weight, min_probes floor = 2 and conservative default thresholds; documented rationale.
María: Add explicit audit fields for forensics (request_sample_ids + snapshot_version). Also ensure RBAC prevents snapshot export.
Author reply: Added export_safe flag and RBAC check in audit_writer; tests added.
CI bot: unit tests failed on first run (race in scheduler throttle). Author pushed fix and re-ran CI.
Daniel: approved after CI green and one nit fixed on log verbosity.
